protocol.train: 15,000 known-intent examples; frozen MiniLM sentence embeddings
protocol.selection: 1,547 development examples from associative-text-v1; no epoch or seed selection
protocol.rejection: All heads use original embedding centroid support with fixed threshold 0.48 from prior development
protocol.loss: Final-step cross entropy; identical minibatch orders within each seed
protocol.prototype_initialization: Mean initial projected training states per class, then normalize

continuation.interpretation: Development screen only; independent confirmation required
